no olive/green except as accents; modern suburban palette (white, warm grey, oak, charcoal)

pieces.name: H_Shell
pieces.note: the house shell as meshes on the layout: exterior walls (outside the inside faces, 1 thick) with the window and door openings cut exactly as house_layout.json openings[], interior walls (1 thick, centred), floor slabs, ceilings, the double-height foyer, roof (pitched over the upper storey, flat roof + 2 skylights over the kitchen x 9..40 y 4..30); split per room so the builder can hide parts; skirting, cornices, door casings.
